independence: A separate program from the export. It reads the served bytes, the review manifest and the pinned sources (the three independent result audits, the two protocols, the three readiness records and the analysis-stage record, plus the pinned handoff and notes for three counts no structured source carries), builds its own table of what every figure and flag must be and shares no extraction code with the export.
figures_from_pinned_text: Bak channels (40): the handoff ("The supplied 40 columns are 20 oxy and 20 deoxy signals"); the protocol lists the channel order but no count
MC_RTT trial length (600 ms): the pinned NLB readiness note ("These 1,080 segments are 600 ms each")
ds007420 recordings excluded (0): the pinned optical quality note ("Recordings checked / excluded | 60 / 0")
checks: each source audit and readiness record is the pinned file and the one the served file names; the served file names the manifest it was built from and the pinned handoff; the two served copies are byte-identical
every number and boolean in the served file has an expected value derived here from the pinned sources, and every expected value is in the file: no unaudited figure or flag and no missing one

copied figures equal the source exactly, type included; the chance level (one over the protocol's classes), the class recalls (diagonal over row of each audited confusion table), the coverage shares and the retained bins are recomputed here
the ridge-versus-mean direction of every MC_RTT metric is recomputed from the audited values; the classifier interval flag from the audited interval and the chance level
each licence is the one its pinned repository record names
no confusion-table cell, runtime, normal-equation residual, acquisition total or free-space reading reaches the file; no private path, server name or raw-file name does

bound: source audit and readiness bytes: pinned in the manifest and named in the served file
every figure and flag: equal to its pinned source or recomputed from it
not_bound: the hash chains behind each audit (protocols, implementations, freeze and preparation reviews) and the rights quotes are verified by the export, not re-read here
prose in the served file is checked by the export (numerals against the pinned sources, claims, labels and identifiers by pattern), not by this audit
